recipes.name: Vegan 'Honey' Mustard Tofu Wraps
instructions: Cut the tofu into 3-inch x ½ inch (8 cm x 1 cm) sticks.
In a medium bowl, mix together the cornstarch, water and soy sauce.
In another bowl, mix together the bread crumbs, nutritional yeast, garlic and paprika powders.
Dip the tofu sticks in the wet mixture, and then into the bread crumbs to coat. Transfer to a plate.
Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add the oil. Cook the tofu for 1 to 2 minutes on each side, or until golden on all sides.
Mix together the maple syrup and mustard in a medium bowl.
Use a silicone pastry brush to coat each cooked tofu strip in the maple-mustard sauce.
Mix the leftover maple-mustard sauce together with the mayo, vinegar and salt.
Add the shredded cabbage and carrot to the bowl with the mustard sauce and mix together.
Assemble the wraps by filling each tortilla with lettuce, tomato, cabbage mix and tofu tenders.
Fold and roll up like a burrito. Then toast them in a pan if desired and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Our large tortillas measure about 10 inches (25 cm) in diameter.

Storage The assembled wraps are best when enjoyed immediately. The tofu tenders can be stored separately from the coleslaw and the other ingredients in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 3 days.
